√īr 'set in motion'
present: [2.] ī́rte ī́rate etc. īráte -- [1.] aírat etc. ī́rate (3s.) 
perfect: īriré erire -- īrāṃ cakre 
[aorist: airirat airiṣṭa īriṣyate īritā ]
verbal: īrṇá B.+ 
secondary: causative: īráyati etc. V.+ īráyate etc. īryate etc. B.+ īritá V.+ īryant īrayádhyai 
derivatives: īra E.+ -īraka C. īrya B. īryā C. īrin E.+ īraṇa E.+ -īraṇīya C. -īritṛ U. īrmá V.B. 
The form īryayati, doubtless false, is found once in ŚB.
